agent_note: My definitions don't include an agent name. The prompt only calls me a 'project specialist' assigned by the main agent, with a role to read tasks and primary sources and report requirements and ambiguities, and no editing.
tools_note: These are the exact function names in my definitions. The prompt's 'Tool Inventory' section uses unprefixed names (read, grep, glob, web_search, yield), which differ from the callable function names for four tools.
browser_note: There is no browser or page-interaction tool. _read can fetch URLs as reader text or raw HTML, and web_search runs web searches. Neither drives a browser.
write_or_shell_note: No tool can write files or run commands. _read, _grep and _glob only read. web_search only queries. _yield only returns the result. The _read description mentions 'proc://' and 'agent://' write semantics, but those apply to other tools that I don't have.
